overview.question: What is FlowSmartly?
overview.answer: FlowSmartly is an AI business operating system for small businesses managing marketing, customer communication, websites, storefronts and daily operations.

capabilities.name: FlowAgent
capabilities.description: Plans work and uses enabled capabilities within workspace authority.

capabilities.name: AI Studio
capabilities.description: Creates and edits content and media from a brief.

capabilities.name: Social
capabilities.description: Plans, schedules and publishes posts to supported connected accounts.

capabilities.name: Email and SMS
capabilities.description: Builds campaigns, reviews qualified audiences and respects recorded consent and opt-outs.

capabilities.name: Ads
capabilities.description: Prepares campaigns for supported ad accounts with budgets and launch checks.

capabilities.name: Sites and FlowShop
capabilities.description: Builds websites and publishes storefronts with product and checkout tools.

capabilities.name: Phone Agent
capabilities.description: Answers calls on configured numbers and follows the business’s call instructions.

capabilities.name: ListSmartly
capabilities.description: Reviews listings and local search presence using recorded sources.

questions.question: What is FlowAgent allowed to do?
questions.answer: FlowAgent can plan work and use the capabilities enabled for a workspace. Workspace permissions, connection status and approval rules determine which work can run automatically or needs someone to approve it.

questions.question: Can FlowSmartly use the tools I already have?
questions.answer: You can connect supported provider accounts in the workspace. Available actions depend on the provider’s permissions, the enabled workspace capabilities and any channel requirements.

questions.question: How do plans and credits work?
questions.answer: Pay as you go has no monthly credit allowance. Paid plans include a monthly allowance and additional credits can be purchased. Pricing lists the plan amounts and Billing shows the options available to your workspace.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Create an account, set up your workspace and add your Brand Identity. Connect a supported account when you are ready to use a capability that needs it.
